scores.evidence: The home screen lands: 'Sete respostas. Uma mina.' over the hatched shaft, with '116 perguntas · 700 m' and the 691 m record; it never looks like a template.
The prompt and 'enter para cravar' are clear, but the answer placeholder is nearly invisible and 'p 19' sitting above '1 em 16' is never defined.
Desktop home/round are composed and legible, but the result headline starts at y=738 on an 800 px viewport, so '691 metros.' is cut off; mobile 'Como medimos' scrolls sideways.
The Fraunces/Plex pairing carries the mine motif well; the mono metadata drops to 9.5 px and the reveal prints '1 wikis' for a single sitelink.
After the fix, Enter shows the full paper reveal ('p 19 / 1 em 16 / 0→63 m') and a timeout reads 'sem resposta'; before, Enter submitted and skipped the sheet entirely.
Monotonic and verified: São Paulo (UF) p 0 → 10 m vs Roraima p 96 → 99 m; Flamengo p 19 → 63 m, Juventude p 34 → 74 m, obvious São Paulo FC p 5 → 45 m.
25 s per prompt, immediate submit/next, no spinner; the timer hits 0 and reveals, though the opening second is busy with the reveal animation.
Playable at 390×844, but the method page scrolls sideways (443 vs 375 px), the result score begins below the 844 px fold, and the reveal wraps '0 → 47' with the 'm' alone.
The mute control swaps ◉/◌ and persists in localStorage; the engine is fully synthesized (no files) with strike/tick/gem voices, but headless playback cannot be judged by ear.
The archive opens past dives, but 'Descer de novo' on the archived 691 m unlimited dive starts the daily instead, and reloading after starting seed 8842 lands on Home.
Invalid structural answers ('clube', 'sport') used to pay 45/54 m; they are now refused. The seed URL, daily memory and streak still misreport.

hillclimb.change: src/game/match.ts: reject a single structural token (clube, futebol, esporte, sport, associacao, municipal, estadio, parque, cidade, estado, time) before any fuzzy match. 'clube' and 'sport' now return 'não está no acervo desta pergunta'; Flamengo, Juventude, São Paulo, Corinthians Alagoano, Londrina, Lagarto, Tijuca and Morumbi still match.

src/screens/Round.tsx: stopPropagation on the submit Enter so the reveal's global handler does not consume the same keypress. src/screens/Reveal.tsx: timeouts now read 'sem resposta' and 'O tempo acabou antes da sua resposta...'. Verified Enter → reveal (p 19, 0→63 m), second Enter → pergunta 2, and a full seven-answer keyboard dive at '318 metros.'

defects.summary: Enter submitted and skipped the reveal.
defects.evidence: Typing 'Flamengo' and pressing Enter once landed on 'Cite um cantor brasileiro que começa com M' with the ledger showing 'Clube de Regatas do Flamengo 63 m' and no sheet.

defects.summary: A structural word bought a real answer.
defects.evidence: 'clube' matched 'São Paulo Futebol Clube' (p 5, 0→45 m); 'sport' matched 'Sport Club Corinthians Paulista' (p 11, 0→54 m).

defects.summary: A timeout claimed the answer was out of catalog.
defects.evidence: With no answer, the sheet read 'o tempo acabou / — / não está no acervo desta pergunta / A sua ficou fora dele...'; it now reads 'sem resposta / O tempo acabou antes da sua resposta...'.

'semente 8842' is rewritten to #s=4020521479; HASH_SEED only accepts 1–4 digits, so reload lands on Home. Opening #s=8842 while the app is already open does nothing because the hash is read only when the dataset loads.

defects.summary: An archived dive replays the wrong thing.
defects.evidence: Opening the 691 m archived dive ('ILIMITADO · SEMENTE 283') and pressing 'Descer de novo' started the daily ('04 nov · pergunta 1/7', 'Cite uma novela dos anos 2000') instead of seed 283.

defects.summary: The daily is stored, never remembered.
defects.evidence: After a 325 m daily, localStorage has dailyDone {'04 nov': {...}}, but Home reads dailyDone['2026-11-04']; the button still says 'Descer' and never 'Descer de novo / hoje: 325 m'.

defects.summary: Unlimited dives reset the daily streak.
defects.evidence: After a daily then seed 283, the store was streak {last: 'semente 283', count: 1}; the archive showed '1 em sequência'.
document.documentElement.scrollWidth was 443 against a 375 px client width; the 405 px table is clipped ('sobre aqu', 'sobre um l', 'postos pe') and a horizontal scrollbar appears.

defects.summary: The result hides its own score.
defects.evidence: .stage already pads 70 px for the topbar and .result adds another 64 px; the plate starts at y=134 and the headline at y=738, ending at y=833, so on 1280×800 '691 metros.' is below the fold. On 390×844 the headline starts at y≈750.

defects.summary: The mobile reveal wraps the unit and the p-value.
defects.evidence: '0 → 47' renders with 'm' alone on the next line, and 'p 6 / 1 em 6' breaks into four lines.

defects.summary: The answer placeholder is effectively invisible.
defects.evidence: .field::placeholder uses #423325 on #171210; 'sua resposta' is almost unreadable at 1280 and 390.
Efó and Cainamé both render 'SITELINKS 1 wikis'; the singular is never handled.

defects.summary: Two rarity scales sit side by side without labels.
defects.evidence: The reveal prints 'p 19' above '1 em 16'; p is the percentile and oneIn is the crowd share. Rio de Janeiro prints 'p 2 / 1 em 2' because 41.8% of the crowd says it. The method page never defines oneIn.

defects.summary: Gem tiers contradict the method table.
defects.evidence: The method maps gems to depth ('Quartzo leitoso ... 0–180 m'), but the result counts gems with tierForRarity(round.p). The 691 m dive shows '7 gemas' although every answer is 97–99 m, i.e. Quartzo on the printed table.

verified: Rare answers always paid more: Roraima 99 m vs São Paulo 10 m; Juventude 74 m vs Flamengo 63 m vs obvious São Paulo FC 45 m.
Empty submit does nothing: the button stays disabled, Enter does not advance, the timer keeps running.
The 25 s timer runs out, reveals, and keeps the round at 0 m; zero is never invented for an unknown answer.
Archive after finishing lists the dive and reopens its result; the 691 m dive is intact.
'Como medimos' is reachable from home, result and archive; source/data claims are legible on desktop.
Sound toggle is real state: ◉ → ◌, aria-label 'ligar som', persisted in garimpo:v1; the engine is procedural.
Two full dives completed: 325 m (obvious) and 691 m (rare); no crash, no stuck state.
After the fixes: Enter shows the reveal and a second Enter advances; a full seven-answer keyboard dive finished at '318 metros.'
